title: Garlic Nutrient Deficiency: Signs, Causes and the Fertilizer That Fixes It
metaTitle: Garlic Nutrient Deficiency: Signs and Fertilizer Fix
metaDescription: Garlic nutrient deficiency shows in the leaves. See the signs of nitrogen, sulfur and potassium in bawang, how to be sure, and the fertilizer to apply.
excerpt: Garlic nutrient deficiency is one of the first things to check when the leaves of your bawang (garlic) turn yellow, purple or burnt at the edges. On Philippine farms the usual ones are nitrogen, sulfur, potassium, phosphorus, boron, zinc, magnesium and calcium. This guide shows where each one starts, how to be sure, and the fertilizer that fixes it.

heroImage.alt: Nitrogen deficiency on a leaf, shown on another crop as a stand in for garlic
heroImage.credit: Maja Dumat, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr

blocks.text: Start with one question: did the change begin on the old leaves or on the young ones? Nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus and magnesium move inside the plant, so a shortage shows on the old, lower leaves first. But sulfur, boron, zinc and calcium stay where the plant first put them, so the young leaves and the growing tip show it first. After that, the color and the pattern narrow down which garlic nutrient deficiency you have, and a soil test confirms it. Each one below has its signs, its causes and its fix.
Garlic nutrient deficiency signs, old leaves and young leaves
Shows first on the old leaves

blocks.caption: Deficiencies that start on the young leaves of bawang

blocks.text: Before you buy fertilizer for a garlic nutrient deficiency

So use the table to pick the likeliest garlic nutrient deficiency, then read its section below. Also keep in mind that dry soil, standing water, cold nights, a pest or a disease can look the same. That is why it pays to check the roots and the whole field first.
Nitrogen deficiency in garlic

The oldest leaves fade to light green and then yellow, growth slows, and plants stay thin and stunted. Bulbs stay small and yield drops. You see it most at this stage: from emergence to the start of bulbing.
Why nitrogen deficiency happens in bawang
Sandy soils low in organic matter, such as many fields that follow rice, and too little nitrogen.
How to tell it apart
Sulfur deficiency yellows the young leaves first. Viruses give yellow stripes along the leaves, not even yellowing. To be sure, check that older leaves yellowed first. Soil test.
What to apply for nitrogen deficiency

About 112 kg N per hectare lifts garlic yield in nine fields out of ten. More helped in only four. Split the nitrogen through early growth. For quick help a 1 percent urea spray (10 g per liter, 160 g in a 16 liter sprayer) can be used.

Sold here with nitrogen: **Atlas Granular Urea (46 0 0)** by Atlas Fertilizer, **Crown Champion Ammonium Sulfate** by Aqua Hydroponic Prime Ventures (21 0 0 with 24 percent sulfur), **Agripower 46 0 0 (Locally Blended) Coated** by Green Acres Agri Tech and **Calcipro** by Ramgo (15.5 0 0 with 18.8 percent calcium). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [urea fertilizer](/blog/urea-fertilizer), and the page on [nitrogen deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/nitrogen-deficiency) in every crop. In anee.io, Anee, the [smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician), reads a photo of the leaf and tells you which nutrient is short.
To keep it away, do not give heavy nitrogen late. It slows maturity and makes the bulbs cure and store poorly. Let a soil test and the crop's color set the season's nitrogen.
Sulfur deficiency in garlic
Young leaves turn evenly yellow first. Plants are thin and weak, and bulbs weigh less and taste less pungent. You see it most at this stage: before and during bulbing.
Why sulfur deficiency happens in bawang
Garlic needs more sulfur than most vegetables. Sandy soils, low organic matter and sulfur free fertilizers bring it on.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen deficiency starts on older leaves. To be sure, soil and leaf test for sulfur. In a soil test, less than 10 ppm of sulfate sulfur is low.
What to apply for sulfur deficiency

Use Ammonium sulfate 21 0 0 for part of the nitrogen, or add Gypsum or single superphosphate, following the soil test. Give about 25 kg sulfur dust per hectare on sulfur poor soils. Give it at planting or with the first side dress.

Sold here with sulfur: **Crown Champion Ammonium Sulfate** by Aqua Hydroponic Prime Ventures (21 0 0 with 24 percent sulfur), **Philphos Gypsum** (22.2 percent calcium and 17.4 percent sulfur), **Harvester Sulphate of Potash** by Universal Harvester (0 0 50 with 17.5 percent sulfur) and **Agsmart Kieserite Granule** (20 percent sulfur and 16.3 percent magnesium). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [ammonium sulfate fertilizer](/blog/ammonium-sulfate-21-0-0), and the page on [sulfur deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/sulfur-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep a sulfur source in every crop. Keep organic matter up with compost, manure or crop residues.
Potassium deficiency in garlic
Older leaves yellow and then die along the edges. Bulbs are smaller with less dry matter and store poorly. You see it most at this stage: bulb enlargement, when potassium demand rises sharply.
Why potassium deficiency happens in bawang
Sandy soils and fields cropped for years without potash. Soils already above 100 ppm potassium give no response, so test first.
How to tell it apart
Leaf blight and purple blotch give spots, not even edge burn. To be sure, soil test for exchangeable potassium.
What to apply for potassium deficiency

Apply Muriate of potash 0 0 60 before planting and, where needed, again during bulbing, following the soil test. Give a potassium sulfate spray of 10 g per liter (160 g in a 16 liter sprayer) for quick help. A usual dose is 1 to 2 bags of Muriate of potash 0 0 60 per hectare, half before transplanting and half when bulbs start to form.

Sold here with potassium: **Atlas Muriate of Potash (MOP)** by Atlas Fertilizer (0 0 60), **Simplot Sulfate 0 0 50** by Nutranta, **Potassium Nitrate** by Parafield (13 0 46) and **Qrop Mix Production 14 0 23 plus 13 Cao** by Farmtech Agriland (14 0 23 with 9.3 percent calcium). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [potash fertilizer](/blog/potash-fertilizer), and the page on [potassium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/potassium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, base potash on a soil test every season. Keep organic matter up with compost, manure or crop residues. Split the potash on sandy soil.
Phosphorus deficiency in garlic
Growth is stunted and slow, and leaves are dark green, sometimes with a reddish purple tint. Roots and bulbs develop poorly. You see it most at this stage: establishment.
Why phosphorus deficiency happens in bawang
Acid and volcanic soils. Garlic's small roots need phosphorus close by at planting.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen deficiency makes leaves pale, not dark. To be sure, soil test for phosphorus. Garlic seldom responds to phosphorus, so add it only when the soil test is low.
What to apply for phosphorus deficiency

Place phosphorus in the root zone at planting, such as 16 20 0 or single superphosphate, following the soil test. A usual basal dose is 4 to 6 bags of Complete 14 14 14 or 2 to 3 bags of Diammonium phosphate 18 46 0 per hectare before transplanting.

Sold here with phosphorus: **Philphos 18 46 0 (Di Ammonium Phosphate)**, **Atlas Super Gro (16 20 0)** by Atlas Fertilizer, **Amigo Planters Granular Single Super Phosphate** by La Filipina (0 18 0 with 11 percent sulfur) and **Triple Super Phosphate** by Newman Chemicals (0 46 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [16 20 0 fertilizer](/blog/16-20-0-fertilizer), and the page on [phosphorus deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/phosphorus-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, band phosphorus near the cloves at planting.
Boron deficiency in garlic
Young leaves grow twisted, and a bad case kills the growing tip. Bulbs crack or grow misshapen. You see it most at this stage: bulbing.
Why boron deficiency happens in bawang
Sandy soils low in organic matter, alkaline soils and dry spells.
How to tell it apart
Calcium deficiency kills young leaf tips and softens bulbs. To be sure, soil test for boron. In a soil test, less than 0.5 ppm of boron is low.
What to apply for boron deficiency

Give about 10 kg Borax per hectare to the soil, or a borax spray of 1 g per liter (16 g in a 16 liter sprayer). Do not exceed it. Boron is toxic in excess. Give boron before flowering: flowers and fruit set need it most.

Sold here with boron: **Etifert 11 (Borax Decahydrate)** by Zetryl Chem (11 percent boron), **Fertibagra 15G** by Unilox Far East Resources (14.6 percent boron), **B17 (Boric Acid)** by Newman Chemicals (17 percent boron) and **Better Yield** by Bacphil Planters Fertilizer (0 0 0.9 with 10 percent boron). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [boron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/boron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, test before applying boron. Test the soil every two or three years. Keep organic matter up with compost, manure or crop residues.
Zinc deficiency in garlic
Young leaves turn pale between the veins and fail to expand fully. Growth is stunted and bulbs form late. You see it most at this stage: early growth.
Why zinc deficiency happens in bawang
Alkaline soils, low organic matter and heavy phosphorus.
How to tell it apart
Iron deficiency also yellows young leaves but bleaches them more. To be sure, soil and leaf test for zinc. In a soil test, less than 0.8 ppm of zinc is low.
What to apply for zinc deficiency

Give about 20 kg Zinc sulfate per hectare, or a morning spray of 2 g zinc sulfate with 2.5 g lime per liter in severe cases. Keep zinc and phosphate apart. Give the soil dose at planting or when the rains begin, and sprays on young growth.

Sold here with zinc: **Harvester Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Universal Harvester (22 percent zinc), **Tierramino ZN** by Unilox Far East Resources (7 0 0 with 10 percent zinc), **Semia** by SCL Filipinas (20 percent zinc) and **Omex Zynergy** by Jardine Distribution (3.8 percent zinc and 2.1 percent copper). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [fertilizer with zinc](/blog/micronutrients-for-rice), and the page on [zinc deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/zinc-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep soil pH between 5 and 7.5. Test the soil every two or three years.
Magnesium deficiency in garlic
Older leaves turn yellow between the veins, sometimes with white tips and oval pale patches. Bulb growth slows. You see it most at this stage: mid season.
Why magnesium deficiency happens in bawang
Acid sandy soils and heavy potash.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen deficiency yellows leaves from the tips and keeps them upright. To be sure, soil test for magnesium.
What to apply for magnesium deficiency

Give about 80 kg magnesium sulfate per hectare in bands near the plants. Use Dolomite on acid soils. Put the soil dose in before planting or when the rains begin. Sprays show results in 10 to 14 days.

Sold here with magnesium: **Dolomite** by A6 Agrisource (24 percent calcium and 11 percent magnesium), **Agsmart Kieserite Granule** (20 percent sulfur and 16.3 percent magnesium), **DDDD Planter's Choice Magnesium Sulphate Monohydrate** by Modern Time (15.1 percent magnesium) and **Zetryl MAG 9** by Zetryl Chem (9 percent magnesium). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [complete fertilizer](/blog/complete-fertilizer-14-14-14), and the page on [magnesium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/magnesium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, lime acid fields with dolomite. Test the soil every two or three years. Keep potash in balance with magnesium and calcium.
Calcium deficiency in garlic
The tips of young leaves die and turn brown, and roots grow less. Bulbing is late, and bulbs are soft and store poorly. You see it most at this stage: bulbing.
Why calcium deficiency happens in bawang
Very acid soils and dry spells that stop calcium moving into the plant. Heavy potash or ammonium fertilizer, salty soil and dry spells keep calcium from reaching fruit and young leaves.
How to tell it apart
Boron deficiency also damages young leaves but cracks the bulbs. To be sure, soil pH and calcium test. A soil test for calcium and pH, and a leaf test, confirm it.
What to apply for calcium deficiency
On acid soils, lime about 250 kg per hectare where the pH is 5.5 to 6. On alkaline soils use Gypsum. Lime 2 to 4 weeks before planting. Calcium sprays go on young fruit from fruit set.

Sold here with calcium: **Micronized Activated Calcite** by CMCS Agricultural Products (37.6 percent calcium), **Dolomite** by A6 Agrisource (24 percent calcium and 11 percent magnesium), **Titon Pro** by Vast Agro (27.2 percent calcium, 6.1 percent silicon and 3.6 percent magnesium) and **Calcipro** by Ramgo (15.5 0 0 with 18.8 percent calcium). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [fertilizer for tomatoes](/blog/fertilizer-for-tomatoes), and the page on [calcium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/calcium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep the soil evenly moist so calcium keeps moving into the bulbs. Test the soil every two or three years. Keep potash in balance with magnesium and calcium.

blocks.title: Let a soil test decide the rate
blocks.text: A soil test is the surest check for any garlic nutrient deficiency. Before you buy, ask your Municipal Agriculture Office where to send a soil sample. The DA regional soil laboratories test soil, and the result says how much of each fertilizer your bawang needs. That saves money, because extra fertilizer is money lost.

blocks.text: Garlic nutrient deficiency questions

items.q: Why are my bawang leaves turning yellow?
items.a: The most common cause is nitrogen deficiency: older leaves turn pale to yellow, plants stay thin, and bulbs are small. If the young leaves turn yellow first instead, look at sulfur deficiency.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes nitrogen deficiency in garlic?
items.a: About 112 kg N per hectare lifts garlic yield in nine fields out of ten. More helped in only four.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes sulfur deficiency in garlic?
items.a: Use Ammonium sulfate 21 0 0 for part of the nitrogen, or add Gypsum or single superphosphate, following the soil test. Give about 25 kg sulfur dust per hectare on sulfur poor soils.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes potassium deficiency in garlic?
items.a: Apply Muriate of potash 0 0 60 before planting and, where needed, again during bulbing, following the soil test. Give a potassium sulfate spray of 10 g per liter (160 g in a 16 liter sprayer) for quick help.

items.q: How do I know which nutrient my bawang lacks?
items.a: First look at where the change began, on the old leaves or the young ones, then at the color and the pattern. Next, confirm the garlic nutrient deficiency with a soil test or a leaf test before you buy fertilizer.
